Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the songwriter credit on the Discogs release page was "Hank Williams" based on a misinterpretation of the visible text in the viewport. The text "Written-By - Hank Williams" visible in the viewport was likely a snippet from a different release (e.g., a Hank Williams original version of "Turn Me On") or a misread element, as the historically correct and widely documented songwriter for the song performed by Norah Jones (a cover of the Mark Dinning/John D. Loudermilk song) is John D. Loudermilk. The Planner failed to verify this against the previously found authoritative source (Wikipedia/Discogs master page results from Step 6) which explicitly stated John D. Loudermilk, instead accepting the ambiguous or conflicting snippet from the specific release page view as definitive proof, leading to the wrong final answer.
